notes.title: Pre-Alpha Demo Update ver. 5.000162 Store and More!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share a new update for the Alien Up pre-alpha demo, featuring a range of improvements and changes based on your feedback. Check it out and let us know what you think about this version as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467505/e9ec385a893f09026604e5d8cc453df767bb0e2e.png
Here’s what’s new:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467505/73579b5d654ce289e6bec7961b95574778af6f5f.png

 Stage Select: Navigate and revisit stages with ease.
 Music Overhaul: Enjoy an improved soundtrack for a more immersive experience.
 Enhanced HP Bars: Bosses and barriers now have more visible health bars.
 Visual Reworks: Refined visuals throughout the demo.
 Event Reworks: Adjusted in-game events for better flow and engagement.
 Store/Soda System: New mechanics for trading sodas and earning upgrades.
 Level Updates: A new level concept has been added, and one level has been removed.
 Minor Tweaks: Countless small details to enhance the overall experience.

There may be even more updates we missed listing here (like the new assist character!), so dive in and explore. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467505/6fb7a197b1c07fbd60f636f33a6d717bf7a66f9a.png
